title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. exits early Sunday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. exited Sunday's contest between the New Orleans Saints against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Ross Jackson.
items.impact: Etienne Jr. headed to the locker room for further evaluation, rushing 13 times for 57 yards while also hauling in both of his targets for 13 yards prior to exiting. Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will take over backfield duties in the running back's absence.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Mike Evans (hip) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Mike Evans (hip) has been ruled out for the remainder of the Week 3 contest between the San Francisco 49ers and Arizona Cardinals according to Nick Wagoner.
items.impact: Evans battled a hip injury prior to the Week 3 contest, hauling in three of his six targets for 34 yards and one touchdown prior to exiting. Deebo Samuel and tight end George Kittle will receive even more opportunities in the wideout's absence for head coach Kyle Shanahan.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Josh Allen reaches end zone on ground twice in Week 3 win over Chargers
items.desc: Josh Allen completed 16-of-26 pass attempts for 204 yards and two interceptions while also rushing eight times for 22 yards and two touchdowns with one fumble lost in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Allen made up for a mistake-filled day behind center rushing for two touchdowns for the third consecutive contests. The quarterback remains locked in as an elite dual-threat option behind center in all formats, with a Week 4 divisional matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: James Cook III dominates on ground in Week 3 win over Chargers
items.desc: James Cook III carried the ball 24 times for 154 yards and one touchdown with one fumble lost in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Cook III has been dynamic out of the backfield of late, rushing for over 130 yards with one touchdown in each of the last two contests. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 4 matchup with the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dalton Kincaid quiet in Week 3 win over Chargers
items.desc: Dalton Kincaid hauled in two of his three targets for 38 yards and one fumble lost in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Kincaid was held in check by the Los Angeles defense, failing to surpass 90 receiving yards for the first time in three contests in the win. The tight end remains one of the more impactful pass-catching options for quarterback Josh Allen, with a Week 4 divisional matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DJ Moore leads pass-catchers in Week 3 win over Chargers
items.desc: DJ Moore hauled in six of his 10 targets for 67 yards in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Moore has been impactful to begin the season, finishing with over 65 receiving yards in two of the first three contests. The wideout remains locked in as a dynamic pass-catching option for quarterback Josh Allen, with a Week 4 matchup against the New England Patriots ahead.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Keon Coleman quiet in Week 3
items.desc: Keon Coleman caught one of his two targets for 37 yards in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
items.impact: Coleman has struggled to make a consistent impact to begin the season, finishing with less than 40 receiving yards in two of the first three games. The speedy wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Khalil Shakir quiet in Week 3 win
items.desc: Khalil Shakir caught one of his three targets for six yards in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Shakir struggled to make an impact Sunday, finishing with less than three receptions for the first time in three contests. The wideout remains one of many risky pass-catching options in the Buffalo offense to this point, with a Week 4 matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ty Johnson hauls in four passes in Week 3 win
items.desc: Ty Johnson hauled in each of his four targets for 50 yards in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
items.impact: Johnson found a way to make an impact in his first game action of the season, finishing second on the team in receiving yards in the win. The running back remains an impactful pass-catching option out of the backfield when healthy, with a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Dawson Knox catches pass in Week 3
items.desc: Dawson Knox caught his only target for five yards in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
items.impact: Knox has made a minimal impact on offense to begin the season, finishing with under 10 receiving yards, three targets, and three receptions in each of the first three contests. The tight end can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jackson Hawes sees one target in Week 3
items.desc: Jackson Hawes failed to catch his only target in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
items.impact: Hawes has been non-existent in the Buffalo offense to begin the season, seeing his first target in three games Sunday. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Bass perfect in Week 3
items.desc: Tyler Bass converted his only field goal attempt as well as all three of his extra point attempts to finish with six points in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
items.impact: Bass has offered modest output to begin the season, recording five or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker benefits from playing behind one of the more high-powered offenses on a regular basis, with a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Cameron Dicker misses field goal in Week 3
items.desc: Cameron Dicker converted 3-of-4 field goal attempts while also making his lone extra point attempt to finish with 10 points in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
items.impact: Dicker made the most of increased opportunities for head coach Jim Harbaugh, finishing with more than two points for the first time in three contests. The kicker has fallen victim to kicking behind an underwhelming Chargers offense to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Justin Herbert struggles again behind center in Week 3 loss to Bills
items.desc: Justin Herbert completed 20-of-34 pass attempts for 226 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while also rushing four times for 17 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Herbert has struggled to make an impact behind center to begin the season, finishing with less than 230 passing yards in each of the first three contests. The quarterback will look to break out of his early season struggles as part of an underperforming Chargers offense against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 4.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Omarion Hampton leads ground attack in Week 3 loss to Bills
items.desc: Omarion Hampton carried the ball 15 times for 56 yards while also failing to catch his lone target in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Hampton struggled to find consistent running room Sunday, rushing for less than 60 yards for the second time in the first three contests. The running back remains one of the more reliable options as part of an inconsistent Chargers offense to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ladd McConkey hauls in four passes in Week 3 loss to Bills
items.desc: Ladd McConkey hauled in four of his five targets for 66 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: McConkey has made the most of inconsistent involvement in the Los Angeles passing attack to begin the season, posting over 65 receiving yards in two of the first three contests. The wideout remains one of the more dynamic options in an underperforming Chargers offense early on, with a tough Week 4 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Quentin Johnston sees six targets in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Quentin Johnston caught three of his six targets for 40 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Johnston has struggled to capitalize on a generous target share early in the season, recording three receptions or less on 17 total targets in the first three contests. The wideout remains one of many risky pass-catching options in an underperforming Chargers offense early on, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) questionable to return Sunday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) is questionable to return for the Minnesota Vikings against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers Sunday.
items.impact: Jefferson headed to the locker room late in the second quarter with the ankle injury, hauling in both of his targets for 32 yards before exiting. Jordan Addison steps into a No. 1 role with Jefferson sidelined.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Keaton Mitchell catches touchdown in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell rushed eight times for 52 yards while also catching each of his three targets for -5 yards and one touchdown in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Mitchell has made a modest impact out of the backfield to begin the season, finishing with less than 50 offensive yards in each of the first three games. The running back remains one of many in an underperforming Chargers offense difficult to trust ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tre' Harris leads pass-catchers in Week 3 loss
items.desc: Tre' Harris hauled in six of his team-high seven targets for 76 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Harris has capitalized on inconsistent usage in the Los Angeles offense of late, leading the team in receiving yards in each of the last two games. The wideout remains one of the more stable pass-catching options as part of an underwhelming Chargers offense to begin the season, with a Week 4 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Oronde Gadsden II sees three targets in Week 3
items.desc: Oronde Gadsden II failed to catch any of his three targets in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
items.impact: Gadsden II has been minimally involved in the Los Angeles passing attack early on, seeing three targets or less in each of the first three games. The tight end remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kimani Vidal sees two touches in Week 3
items.desc: Kimani Vidal rushed once for six yards while also catching one of his three targets for 14 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
items.impact: Vidal has struggled to make an impact to begin the season, recording his first touches in three games in Sunday's loss. The running back can remain off rosters until further notice, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Alec Ingold catches three passes in Week 3
items.desc: Alec Ingold caught three of his four targets for 35 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
items.impact: Ingold has been non-existent in the Los Angeles passing attack to begin the season, seeing his first targets in three games in Sunday's loss. The fullback can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling sees one target in Week 3
items.desc: Marquez Valdes-Scantling failed to catch his only target in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
items.impact: Valdes-Scantling saw minimal involvement in the passing attack after being added to the active roster earlier in the week, finishing last on the team in targets. The veteran wideout can remain off rosters in all formats, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Marcus Mariota exits early Sunday
items.desc: Marcus Mariota exited early with an apparent injury for the Washington Commanders against the Seattle Seahawks Sunday according to Nicki Jhabvala.
items.impact: Mariota suffered the undisclosed injury while scrambling late in the fourth quarter, completing 19-of-30 pass attempts for 184 yards and three touchdowns and rushing twice for four yards prior to exiting.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Garrett Wilson exits Sunday
items.desc: Garrett Wilson exited Sunday's contest between the New York Jets and Detroit Lions with an apparent injury.
items.impact: Wilson was seen limping to the sideline late in the fourth quarter for head coach Aaron Glenn, hauling in 10 of his team-leading 13 targets for 107 yards and one touchdown before exiting.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Breece Hall (thigh) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Breece Hall (thigh) has been ruled out for the New York Jets against the Detroit Lions Sunday.
items.impact: Hall suffered the apparent injury early in the fourth quarter, rushing 13 times for 32 yards while also catching all three of his targets for 23 yards prior to exiting. Braelon Allen will take over No. 1 backfield duties for head coach Aaron Glenn against the Lions.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jalen Coker (quad) out for the remainder of Week 3
items.desc: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (quad) has been ruled out for the remainder of the game against Cleveland.
items.impact: Coker was questionable to play today but that was due to an ankle injury. Coker has now picked up a new injury and will not return. He will finish the day with 18 receiving yards on two receptions.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Ollie Gordon II (cramping) questionable to return
items.desc: Dolphins RB Ollie Gordon II (cramping) is questionable to return Sunday.
items.impact: Gordon jogged off to the locker room and is now officially questionable to return. This is a big blow to the Dolphins' offense with De'Von Achane (knee) already ruled out.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) questionable to return
items.desc: Commanders RB Rachaad White is questionable to return Sunday due to a shoulder injury.
items.impact: White had four rushing yards on two carries and one receptions for six yards prior to the injury. Jacory Croskey-Merritt will continue to see the bulk of the carries with White sidelined.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) active for Week 3
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) is officially active for Week 3 for the Las Vegas Raiders against the New Orleans Saints.
items.impact: Bowers will take the field for his regular season debut after passing through pregame testing on his knee without any setbacks, providing quarterback Kirk Cousins with a dynamic pass-catching option against the Saints Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: De'Von Achane (knee) ruled out
items.desc: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane has officially been ruled out for the remainder of Week 3 with a knee injury.
items.impact: Achane was tackled awkwardly in the first quarter and was taken to the locker room for further evaluation. Ollie Gordon will handle the primary running back duties for the remainder of the game against the Chiefs. He will finish the day with 17 yards on three carries.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) active for Week 3
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) is officially active for Week 3 for the Baltimore Ravens against the Dallas Cowboys according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Flowers will suit up for head coach Jesse Minter after passing through pregame warmups without any issues, although the superstar wideout will likely receive a reduced workload against the Cowboys Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) officially inactive for Week 3
items.desc: Panthers WR Xavier Legette (knee) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Browns.
items.impact: Legette was a late add to the Panthers' injury report on Thursday and was limited on Friday. Brycen Tremayne and John Metchie will see increased playing time behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jaylen Wright (stinger/foot) inactive for Week 3
items.desc: Jaylen Wright (stinger/foot) is inactive for Week 3 for the Miami Dolphins against the Kansas City Chiefs.
items.impact: Wright will sit out after being unable to make enough progress throughout the week to suit up, as Ollie Gordon II will see increased touches behind No. 1 running back De'Von Achane against a stout Chiefs defense Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (back) officially inactive for Week 3
items.desc: Steelers DB Joey Porter Jr. (back) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Bengals.
items.impact: Porter was listed as questionable to play and will now have to wait at least one more week to make his season debut. This is a big boost for the Bengals' offense as the Steelers will be without a key piece of their secondary.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Christian Mahogany (hip) active for Week 3
items.desc: Christian Mahogany (hip) is active for Week 3 for the Detroit Lions against the New York Jets.
items.impact: Mahogany will take the field after being sidelined in Week 2 for head coach Dan Campbell, joining rookie Blake Miller (knee) in returning to a Detroit offensive line that will look to keep quarterback Jared Goff clean against the Jets Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Blake Miller (knee) active for Week 3
items.desc: Blake Miller (knee) is active for Week 3 for the Detroit Lions against the New York Jets.
items.impact: Miller is good to go after progressing throughout the practice week, boosting a Detroit offensive line that will look to keep quarterback Jared Goff upright against the Jets defense Sunday.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) officially active for Week 3
items.desc: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder) is officially active for a Week 3 matchup with the Bengals.
items.impact: Warren was limited in practice throughout the week but will play and start against the Bengals. With Rico Dowdle (toe) inactive, Warren could be in line for a workhorse role in Week 3.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) officially inactive for Week 3
items.desc: Browns DB Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with Carolina.
items.impact: Campbell was considered as questionable this week, but was dealing with multiple injuries and will not be available against the Panthers. Noah Igbinoghene and Mekhi Blackmon should see additional playing time with Campbell out.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) active for Week 3
items.desc: Ed Oliver (hip) is active for Week 3 for the Buffalo Bills against the Los Angeles Chargers according to Cameron Wolfe.
items.impact: Oliver takes the field after clearing through pregame activities without any setbacks, boosting a Buffalo front seven that will look to disrupt a Chargers offense still looking for some consistency entering the Week 3 contest.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Devin Singletary officially inactive for Week 3
items.desc: Giants RB Devin Singletary is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Titans.
items.impact: Singletary is a healthy inactive for the Giants after averaging just 2.8 yards per carry in the first two games. Najee Harris will serve as the primary backup to Cam Skattebo.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) officially inactive for Week 3
items.desc: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) is officially inactive for Week 3.
items.impact: Mitchell was listed as questionable to play against the Lions after suffering the injury in practice Thursday. Isaiah Williams will likely see an increased role with Mitchell sidelined.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Eli Raridon (thigh) officially inactive for Week 3
items.desc: Patriots TE Eli Raridon (thigh) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Jaguars.
items.impact: Raridon injured his thigh in Week 2 and was considered questionable to play Sunday. With Raridon out, Hunter Henry should see even more playing time against Jacksonville.

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.title: Tyjae Spears (ankle) officially active for Week 3
items.desc: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (ankle) is officially active for a Week 3 matchup with the Giants.
items.impact: Spears was listed as questionable to play Sunday, but was able to return and practice Friday. He should be expected to split time with Tony Pollard against the Giants.
